subject: Kickoff: joint evaluation roadmap + MAP draft (Medicos)
messages:
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@medicos.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: joint evaluation roadmap + MAP draft (Medicos)

Hi Lena — great to meet last week. As promised, attaching a starter Mutual Action Plan and a compact 30-day evaluation playbook to align on what success looks like and the checkpoints we recommend.

High-level proposed timeline (editable in the doc):
- Week 0 (tech check): infra/access, sample dataset ingestion, perf baseline
- Week 1: initial integration + feature validation (key flows)
- Week 2: quality review and prompt tuning iteration
- Week 3: scale & regression checks, cost estimates
- Week 4: acceptance run and decision meeting

Asks from our side: could you confirm the primary stakeholders (product, infra, security) and preferred dates for the Week 0 tech cal? I put placeholders in the MAP template.

Links / attachments:
- Medicos_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (editable) — outline, milestone owners, acceptance criteria
- 30d-eval-playbook-slides.pptx — slide deck with weekly goals and owner RACI

Next steps I suggest: quick 30-min sync to lock Week 0 + finalize stakeholder roster. Tomorrow or Wednesday morning PT works on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment stubs: Medicos_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc), 30d-eval-playbook-slides.pptx (PowerPoint)
From: Lena Park <lena.park@medicos.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@medicos.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: joint evaluation roadmap + MAP draft (Medicos)

Thanks Hiro — and thanks for the clear starter pack. Quick responses and a few requests: 

1) Stakeholders: I'll be the product lead (Lena Park). Tom O'Neill (cc) will own infra/security. I'll add a couple more folks to the map after a quick check with legal.

2) Timeline tweak: can we shift the acceptance/decision meeting out by one week to give our data team more runway for synthetic load tests? So move acceptance to Week 5. Not a blocker — just want to avoid cramming validation with performance runs.

3) Compliance ask: Tom, can you confirm whether we need a SOC2 readout or any infra diagrams before Week 0? If so, please indicate what format you prefer and we can slot time to provide it.

4) Proposed Week 0 availability: Nov 29–30 for the tech connect. Both days are currently best for our infra.

If possible could you update the MAP doc with the Week 5 acceptance change and make the Week 0 slot editable so I can add names? I'll also upload our stakeholder list this afternoon.

Cheers,
Lena
Director of Product, Medicos
lena.park@medicos.com
